task.title: Stop writing a post-approval closeout commit that invalidates its own review

owned: owner-finalize context materialization that preserves reviewed task-brief bytes and never transcribes review_approved into a fresh brief
closeout and wakeup guardrails that forbid approval-record commits after review
side-effect-free, pagination-fail-closed classification of a direct generated task-brief successor
full canonical review-gate evaluation before GitHub proof publication
proof-tag, ref, and required-workflow publication before CI rollup evaluation, followed by a later green-pass exact-head merge
negative regression coverage for review_not_approved and failed proof publication
not_changing: supervisor scheduling or worker selection policy

post_approval_brief_rewrite_removed_at_s.evidence: owned_finalize_dispatch preserves an existing reviewed task brief byte-for-byte; a fresh finalize workspace gets a stable brief that points to governed show instead of copying review_approved or next into branch-local content. Closeout and wakeup instructions explicitly forbid committing generated approval records.

commit_file_pagination_fails_closed.evidence: The classifier requests the maximum 100-file GitHub commit page and rejects a full page, so an omitted later page cannot hide a non-task-brief code change behind task-brief-only files.

rejected_gate_has_no_publication_side_ef.evidence: The integration regression retains a prior unrevoked approval and a direct task-brief-only successor while canonical status is review, then proves no tag, ref, workflow dispatch, or PR merge command is emitted.

approved_successor_publishes_before_red_.evidence: The execute-path regression begins with the successor canonical review check at FAILURE, then proves tag/ref/workflow publication occurs after task_brief_only_approval_carried_forward and before the full CI rollup can block. That first pass waits with no merge; after the canonical check becomes SUCCESS, a later pass reuses the proof without re-dispatching and merges the exact head.

publication_failure_blocks_merge.evidence: The regression injects a review-proof tag write failure and proves the integration result is blocked with no PR merge command.

dispatch_failure_is_not_silently_ignored.evidence: The bridge regression proves a carry-forward workflow-dispatch failure raises GitHubReviewBridgeError after proof publication, allowing the integrator to fail closed.

verification.result: 130 unittest cases passed, including the pagination boundary, red canonical-check carry-forward regression, and task-brief finalization guards

verification.command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m py_compile scripts/git/auto_integrator.py scripts/git/github_review_bridge.py scripts/git/task_review_merge_gate.py .orchestrator/supervisor.py .orchestrator/watch_events.py && git diff --check

review.note: Antigravity must independently review the exact pushed PR head and bind this already-committed manifest with REVIEW_FILE during the governed approve command.
